title: Grateful Dead Live at Alfred College on 1970-05-01

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording capturing a ripping performance of The Race Is On
ai_review.review: The reviewer gave the set a full five stars, praising both the audio fidelity and the band’s spirited take on George Jones’ “The Race Is On.”  The sound quality is described as loving, implying an excellent, clear capture, while the performance itself brought a grin to the listener.  No technical flaws or musical shortcomings were noted.

ai_rating.rationale: Single five‑star review praises both the show and recording; strong positivity suggests a high rating but limited data lowers confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer explicitly says “Love the quality,” with no mention of flaws or noise.
